payload.body: ISSUE:0007 status from dc: wiring landed, a 0.1.9 cut blocker found in devbin, and one design change. LANDED: 9cc5f93 (the version line, the install: block), 78cabdc (the formula on @@INSTALL@@, each archive rooted at the install root, the signer and its tests), 802de63 (the tree and each archive hold bin/ccusage alone). RUN SO FAR, Desk slot 01M79VNKJ75Q7EFHCF89QQS4TW at 78cabdc (HEAD 988dde7 added only your intent records): bin/devbin check all green; cargo test --test cli 31 of 31, the two new version tests and the ccusage use tests among them; bats tests/macos.bats 45 of 45; bin/devbin build stamps ccusage 0.1.8 (dev, 988dde76d485); a v0.1.8 render with stand-in sums parses, and brew style finds no formula offense. Still to run, in a second slot once the P1 devvm build is done: bats on 802de63's signer, bin/devbin install to a scratch prefix, use dev and opt under a scratch HOME, and doctor. BLOCKER: release.gates runs doctor, and devbin 0.1.23's doctor exits 1 on hv's Mac while the 0.1.8 keg is installed, as it will be at the cut. (a) Switch row: the first ccusage on PATH is not Homebrew's, with the remedy to move /opt/homebrew/bin/ccusage aside; the 0.1.8 link resolves to libexec/ccusage, not libexec/bin/ccusage (lib/helpers, tool_brew_answer_state and tool_brew_path_why). (b) Tree row: the keg does not match its manifest, missing LICENSE and README.md; doctor reads the pre-line manifest's body and fails before its own old-form note (lib/cmd/doctor 1376-1404). devbin's T3 says a pre-contract keg is a note naming brew upgrade, never a failure, because that release's own cut runs doctor on a machine still holding the old keg, and that the shadow check keeps working on it. So the cut's doctor leg stays red until devbin fixes both rows in a release Ccusage vendors, or hv rules on the gate. I am sending devbin-vc the defect as a finding; the routing and the ruling are yours. DESIGN CHANGE, 802de63: no LICENSE in the tree. Homebrew's build.rb (232-236) moves metafiles out of libexec after the install when the keg's root has none, as a keg laid out from an archive has; that is why 0.1.8's keg fails (b). So the release archives and the macOS keg no longer carry LICENSE; a Linux keg gets LICENSE and README at its root from the checkout, as Homebrew metafiles. Keeping the license in the archives would need a devbin change to its assets body. KEY NAMES vs the outline: install.prefix and install.links as planned, install.files unused, install.manifest left at its default .ccusage-install, and formula.bin retired; I added build.inputs (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, src), T4's declared input set, and devbin_version ^0.1.23. The prefix is ~/Devel/opt/ccusage, beside devbin's ~/Devel/opt/devbin. THE READER is the contract's word for word, except that its three nested ifs are one let chain: Clippy 0.1.99's collapsible_if fails the snippet as written in an edition 2024 crate, three errors. The hand-over follows the second slot.
